mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN s.shipping_status = 'PREPARING' THEN 1 END) AS preparing_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.shipping_status = 'SHIPPING' THEN 1 END) AS shipping_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.shipping_status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 END) AS delivered_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.shipping_status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END) AS cancelled_count FROM ORDERS o JOIN SHIPPING s on s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId}
